summary: @nebula.js/nucleus 0.5.1 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js
details: This version of @nebula.js/nucleus adds a preinstall hook (`scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`) that is not present in the legitimate qlik-oss/nebula.js upstream. setup.mjs downloads the Bun standalone runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (URL built as `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], { cwd: D })`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB, three-line file using obfuscator.io-style array-shift string decoding with hex-named identifiers (e.g. `function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }`) — its contents are not readable without decoding. package.json reuses the legitimate publisher's identity (`author: QlikTech International AB`, `repository: qlik-oss/nebula.js`) as cover, but the preinstall hook, setup.mjs, and math_init.js do not exist in the upstream package. Installing the package on default `npm install` executes the obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime before any consumer code runs, bypassing Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
